firstPlayerRule: Choose the starting player at random. The first round proceeds clockwise.
clarifications: Choose Clans in reverse turn order, starting with the last player. Place the first Workers in clockwise order from the starting player, then place the second Workers in reverse order.
Later rounds follow the order in which players passed.
